title: Monday Daily Practice
subtitle: Class day B8: guess the 8 student life words, say them aloud
source: Foundation 11 lesson plan, week 6 (B8 Putting it all together, B9 Hobbies and free time), 2026-11-16
intro: Class day. 15-minute warm-up only. Do not submit. Bring your notes to class tonight. Vocab Quest: open Foundation Vocab Quest on the website and finish today's 18 words (Week 6).

steps.title: Step 1 · Guess the meaning
steps.instructions: These are tonight's 8 new words. Choose the best meaning. It is OK to guess.

options.A: money you pay for your room
options.B: the land and buildings of a university

options.C: money a school gives you to study
a person who sells fresh food
a place where students buy and eat food

options.A: a few students who study together
options.B: an extra class with a teacher

options.A: money you pay when you are late
options.B: money you pay to study at a school
options.C: money you get for good marks
work a team of students does together

steps.title: Step 2 · Say it aloud
steps.instructions: Say each word 3 times. Watch the stress: CAMpus, SCHOLarship, FRESHman, cafeTEria. You do not need to send it today.
lines: campus · scholarship · freshman · cafeteria · hall of residence · study group · tuition fee · group project
steps.note: Teacher listens for word stress. Not scored.
